sampling: 20 evenly spaced row indices within each original recording group, including endpoints; no labels or model results used
training_initialization: same seed7 initialization; changed data is a new training run, not exact resume
failure_handling: Keep all collection failures; train only complete four-condition frames with all six offline labels; no substitution; require >=90 percent of selected frames per role and all original recording groups
validation_scope: expanded existing development recording groups, not an independent test
pipeline: export independent offline labels and rows
reload and independently verify metrics including old development subset
runtime_estimate: roughly 2-4 hours total from prior per-frame collection and training timings, subject to scene density and I/O
method_claim: driver data-scaling study, not sequential-policy superiority
